cd /home/ubuntu/upload && python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv, glob, collections
data={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.csv')):
    with open(f, encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as fh:
        rows=list(csv.reader(fh))[1:]
    for r in rows:
        data.setdefault(r[0],[]).append((f,r[1],r[2]))
dups={k:v for k,v in data.items() if len(v)>1}
print("total unique ids:", len(data), "dup ids:", len(dups))
# conflict check
conf=[(k,v) for k,v in dups.items() if len({(x[1],x[2]) for x in v})>1]
print("dup with differing channel/amount:", len(conf))
for k,v in list(conf)[:10]: print(k,v)
print("--- sample dups")
for k,v in list(dups.items())[:6]: print(k,v)
# per-file id ranges
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.csv')):
    with open(f, encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as fh:
        rows=list(csv.reader(fh))[1:]
    ids=[r[0] for r in rows]
    print(f, ids[0], ids[-1], "sorted?", ids==sorted(ids))
# overlap between ranges
sets={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.csv')):
    with open(f, encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as fh:
        rows=list(csv.reader(fh))[1:]
    sets[f]=set(r[0] for r in rows)

print("A&B",len(a&b),"A&C",len(a&c),"B&C",len(b&c))
print(sorted(a&c))
EOF

args.content:
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""合并三份销售表 -> 销售汇总.xlsx（只读原始文件，不修改）"""
import csv
from collections import OrderedDict
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, PatternFill, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

SRC = ["/home/ubuntu/upload/销售表A.csv",
       "/home/ubuntu/upload/销售表B.csv",
       "/home/ubuntu/upload/销售表C.csv"]
OUT = "/home/ubuntu/销售汇总.xlsx"

raw = []          # 原始全部记录
for path in SRC:
    name = path.split("/")[-1]
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as fh:
        rows = list(csv.reader(fh))
    header, body = rows[0], rows[1:]
    assert header == ["订单编号", "渠道", "金额"], (name, header)
    for r in body:
        raw.append({"来源": name, "订单编号": r[0].strip(),
                    "渠道": r[1].strip(), "金额原文": r[2].strip()})

# 去重：同订单编号只保留一条；金额缺失者优先保留有金额的记录
dedup = OrderedDict()
dup_cnt = 0
missing_map = OrderedDict()
for rec in raw:
    oid = rec["订单编号"]
    try:
        amt = float(rec["金额原文"]) if rec["金额原文"] != "" else None
    except ValueError:
        amt = None
    rec["金额"] = amt
    if oid in dedup:
        dup_cnt += 1
        if dedup[oid]["金额"] is None and amt is not None:
            rec["来源"] = dedup[oid]["来源"] + "+" + rec["来源"]
            dedup[oid] = rec
        elif amt is not None:
            dedup[oid]["来源"] = dedup[oid]["来源"] + "+" + rec["来源"]
    else:
        dedup[oid] = rec

dedup_rows = list(dedup.values())
missing = [r for r in dedup_rows if r["金额"] is None]
valid = [r for r in dedup_rows if r["金额"] is not None]

# 按渠道统计
chan = OrderedDict()
for r in valid:
    c = chan.setdefault(r["渠道"], {"订单数": 0, "销售额": 0.0})
    c["订单数"] += 1
    c["销售额"] += r["金额"]
total_amt = round(sum(c["销售额"] for c in chan.values()), 2)
total_cnt = sum(c["订单数"] for c in chan.values())
miss_chan = OrderedDict()
for r in missing:
    miss_chan[r["渠道"]] = miss_chan.get(r["渠道"], 0) + 1

# ---------- 写 Excel ----------
wb = Workbook()
HDR = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
HDRFILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="4472C4")
TITLE = Font(bold=True, size=13)
BOLD = Font(bold=True)
THIN = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
BOX = Border(left=THIN, right=THIN, top=THIN, bottom=THIN)
MONEY = '#,##0.00'


def write_table(ws, start_row, headers, rows, money_cols=()):
    for j, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
        c = ws.cell(row=start_row, column=j, value=h)
        c.font, c.fill, c.border = HDR, HDRFILL, BOX
        c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
    for i, row in enumerate(rows, start_row + 1):
        for j, v in enumerate(row, 1):
            c = ws.cell(row=i, column=j, value=v)
            c.border = BOX
            if j in money_cols:
                c.number_format = MONEY
    return start_row + len(rows)


# Sheet1 销售汇总
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "销售汇总"
ws["A1"] = "销售数据汇总（已合并 3 份表并按订单编号去重）"
ws["A1"].font = TITLE
ws.merge_cells("A1:D1")
info = [
    ("原始记录总条数", len(raw)),
    ("合并去重后订单数", len(dedup_rows)),
    ("重复订单删除条数", dup_cnt),
    ("含有效金额订单数", len(valid)),
    ("金额缺失订单数", len(missing)),
]
r = 3
for k, v in info:
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=k).font = BOLD
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=v)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left")
    r += 1

r += 1
ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="按渠道统计销售额").font = TITLE
r += 1
chan_start = r
rows = [[c, d["订单数"], round(d["销售额"], 2)] for c, d in chan.items()]
rows.append(["合计", total_cnt, total_amt])
write_table(ws, chan_start, ["渠道", "订单数", "销售额"], rows, money_cols=(3,))
for j in range(1, 4):  # 合计行加粗
    ws.cell(row=chan_start + len(rows), column=j).font = BOLD

r = chan_start + len(rows) + 2
ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="金额缺失订单（未计入上表销售额）").font = TITLE
r += 1
mrows = [[r_["订单编号"], r_["渠道"], r_["来源"]] for r_ in missing]
write_table(ws, r, ["订单编号", "渠道", "来源文件"], mrows)
mr = r + len(mrows) + 1
ws.cell(row=mr, column=1, value="缺失渠道分布：").font = BOLD
ws.cell(row=mr, column=2, value="；".join(f"{k} {v} 条" for k, v in miss_chan.items()))

for col, w in zip("ABCD", (24, 14, 14, 14)):
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

# Sheet2 去重后明细
ws2 = wb.create_sheet("去重后明细")
drows = [[r_["订单编号"], r_["渠道"],
          r_["金额"] if r_["金额"] is not None else "金额缺失", r_["来源"]]
         for r_ in sorted(dedup_rows, key=lambda x: x["订单编号"])]
write_table(ws2, 1, ["订单编号", "渠道", "金额", "来源文件"], drows, money_cols=(3,))
for col, w in zip("ABCD", (14, 10, 14, 22)):
    ws2.column_dimensions[col].width = w

# Sheet3 金额缺失订单
ws3 = wb.create_sheet("金额缺失订单")
write_table(ws3, 1, ["订单编号", "渠道", "原始金额", "来源文件"],
            [[r_["订单编号"], r_["渠道"], r_["金额原文"] or "(空)", r_["来源"]] for r_ in missing])
for col, w in zip("ABCD", (14, 10, 12, 24)):
    ws3.column_dimensions[col].width = w

wb.save(OUT)
print("原始:", len(raw), "去重后:", len(dedup_rows), "重复删除:", dup_cnt,
      "缺金额:", len(missing), "有效:", len(valid))
for c, d in chan.items():
    print(f"  {c}: {d['订单数']} 单, {round(d['销售额'],2):.2f}")
print("合计:", total_cnt, total_amt)

    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=k).font = BOLD
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=v)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left")
    r += 1

r += 1
ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="按渠道统计销售额").font = TITLE
r += 1
chan_start = r
rows = [[c, d["订单数"], round(d["销售额"], 2)] for c, d in chan.items()]
rows.append(["合计", total_cnt, total_amt])
write_table(ws, chan_start, ["渠道", "订单数", "销售额"], rows, money_cols=(3,))
for j in range(1, 4):  # 合计行加粗
    ws.cell(row=chan_start + len(rows), column=j).font = BOLD

r = chan_start + len(rows) + 2
ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="金额缺失订单（未计入上表销售额）").font = TITLE
r += 1
mrows = [[r_["订单编号"], r_["渠道"], r_["来源"]] for r_ in missing]
write_table(ws, r, ["订单编号", "渠道", "来源文件"], mrows)
mr = r + len(mrows) + 1
ws.cell(row=mr, column=1, value="缺失渠道分布：").font = BOLD
ws.cell(row=mr, column=2, value="；".join(f"{k} {v} 条" for k, v in miss_chan.items()))

for col, w in zip("ABCD", (24, 14, 14, 14)):
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

# Sheet2 去重后明细
ws2 = wb.create_sheet("去重后明细")
drows = [[r_["订单编号"], r_["渠道"],
          r_["金额"] if r_["金额"] is not None else "金额缺失", r_["来源"]]
         for r_ in sorted(dedup_rows, key=lambda x: x["订单编号"])]
write_table(ws2, 1, ["订单编号", "渠道", "金额", "来源文件"], drows, money_cols=(3,))
for col, w in zip("ABCD", (14, 10, 14, 22)):
    ws2.column_dimensions[col].width = w

# Sheet3 金额缺失订单
ws3 = wb.create_sheet("金额缺失订单")
write_table(ws3, 1, ["订单编号", "渠道", "原始金额", "来源文件"],
            [[r_["订单编号"], r_["渠道"], r_["金额原文"] or "(空)", r_["来源"]] for r_ in missing])
for col, w in zip("ABCD", (14, 10, 12, 24)):
    ws3.column_dimensions[col].width = w

wb.save(OUT)
print("原始:", len(raw), "去重后:", len(dedup_rows), "重复删除:", dup_cnt,
      "缺金额:", len(missing), "有效:", len(valid))
for c, d in chan.items():
    print(f"  {c}: {d['订单数']} 单, {round(d['销售额'],2):.2f}")
print("合计:", total_cnt, total_amt)
